name: Creating a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Added' email to every admin
description:
Objective: Creating a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Added' email to every admin.
Preconditions: Open Permission set emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Permission set emails.
2. Creating a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Added' email to every admin.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Creating a permission set must send PERMISSION_SET_ADDED to every active admin other than the one who created it, naming the new set.
